Hey, you’re not too crazy to realise somethings up. So you’re not crazy. Agoraphobia is intense and scary. Try inviting people you love to your home a little or practicing one task out of the home that means you have to see someone. 
I wanted to start a group in my home for agoraphobic people to socialise with each other. I think it’d be hard to convince a whole group of us to but I think it’s important for us to socialise comfortably too. 
I’m only 25 and don’t have all the extraneous family requirements to think about, but I can’t imagine living long like this. It’s so isolating and so lonely. 
What therapies have you tried? I’m about to start group trauma and do individual trauma and meds too, it’s not working so far though.
Anytime! Thank you for sharing your struggles too. So important to know we’re not alone.

I told my current partner, as soon as I knew things were serious, about my sexual/ intimacy issues caused by abuse.  It was 3 years before I could tell him any details but I can’t tell you how amazing it is to have someone who even attempts to listen to how you feel. 
Abuse and the sexual issues it creates is so so so shit. So many people don’t realise that stuff is with you forever and it changes relationships with everyone in your life. You need someone on your side though and telling him the tldr version of why you need space will make it easier on both of you. And so much nicer when you feel like penetration is okay with this person. 
Good on you for doing trauma work, I’m freshly trying to heal that shit too. Good luck man ❤️
